name: GA4GH Pedigree Validator
summary: Structural validation for GA4GH pedigree documents, exposed as a Cordis plugin, a bundled skill, and a standalone MCP server
description:
Structural validation for GA4GH pedigree documents, exposed as a Cordis plugin, a bundled skill, and a standalone MCP server.

**Install**: not published to npm or any other package registry. Clone and build the `ga4gh-plugins` repository, then run this package's standalone stdio MCP server with Node, using an absolute path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/susheel/ga4gh-plugins.git
cd ga4gh-plugins && pnpm install && pnpm run build
node /absolute/path/to/ga4gh-plugins/packages/pedigree/lib/bin.js
```
